Package io.webagent4j.observation

Record Class ObservedElementState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.observation.ObservedElementState
Record Components:
interaction - Phase 2 state snapshot
required - whether a form field is required
expanded - expanded state when the backend can determine it
public record ObservedElementState(ElementState interaction, boolean required, Optional<Boolean> expanded) extends Record
Compact immutable semantic state that reuses the Phase 2 interaction state and adds reliable observation-only flags.
